columns.name: AJCC_Clinical_N
columns.description: Extent of the regional lymph node involvement for the cancer based on evidence obtained from clinical assessment parameters determined prior to treatment.

columns.name: Gross_Tumor_Weight
columns.description: Numeric value used to describe the gross pathologic tumor weight, measured in grams.

columns.name: Days_to_Last_Follow_up
columns.description: Time interval from the date of last follow up to the date of initial pathologic diagnosis, represented as a calculated number of days. If not applicable please enter 'Not Applicable'

columns.name: Percent_Tumor_Invasion
columns.description: The percentage of tumor cells spread locally in a malignant neoplasm through infiltration or destruction of adjacent tissue.

columns.name: AJCC_Pathologic_Stage
columns.description: The extent of a cancer, especially whether the disease has spread from the original site to other parts of the body based on AJCC staging criteria.

columns.name: INPC_Histologic_Group
columns.description: The text term used to describe the classification of neuroblastomas distinguishing between favorable and unfavorable histologic groups. The histologic score, defined by the International Neuroblastoma Pathology Classification (INPC), is based on age, mitosis-karyorrhexis index (MKI), stromal content and degree of tumor cell differentiation.

columns.name: Metastasis_at_Diagnosis_Site
columns.description: Text term to identify an anatomic site in which metastatic disease involvement is found.

columns.name: Synchronous_Malignancy
columns.description: A yes/no/unknown indicator used to describe whether the patient had an additional malignant diagnosis at the same time the tumor used for sequencing was diagnosed. If both tumors were sequenced, both tumors would have synchronous malignancies.

columns.name: Prior_Malignancy
columns.description: The yes/no/unknown indicator used to describe the patient's history of prior cancer diagnosis.

columns.name: IRS_Stage
columns.description: The text term used to describe the classification of rhabdomyosarcoma tumors, as defined by the Intergroup Rhabdomyosarcoma Study (IRS).

columns.name: Days_to_Recurrence
columns.description: Number of days between the date used for index and the date the patient's disease recurred. If not applicable please enter 'Not Applicable'

columns.name: Best_Overall_Response
columns.description: The best improvement achieved throughout the entire course of protocol treatment.

columns.name: Metastasis_at_Diagnosis
columns.description: The text term used to describe the extent of metastatic disease present at diagnosis.

columns.name: AJCC_Pathologic_T
columns.description: Code of pathological T (primary tumor) to define the size or contiguous extension of the primary tumor (T), using staging criteria from the American Joint Committee on Cancer (AJCC).

columns.name: Gleason_Grade_Group
columns.description: The text term used to describe the overall grouping of grades defined by the Gleason grading classification, which is used to determine the aggressiveness of prostate cancer. Note that this grade describes the entire prostatectomy specimen and is not specific to the sample used for sequencing.

columns.name: Age_at_Diagnosis
columns.description: Age at the time of diagnosis expressed in number of days since birth.

columns.name: AJCC_Pathologic_M
columns.description: Code to represent the defined absence or presence of distant spread or metastases (M) to locations via vascular channels or lymphatics beyond the regional lymph nodes, using criteria established by the American Joint Committee on Cancer (AJCC).

columns.name: Mitotic_Count
columns.description: The number of mitoses identified under the microscope in tumors. The method of counting varies, according to the specific tumor examined. Usually, the mitotic count is determined based on the number of mitoses per high power field (40X) or 10 high power fields.

columns.name: IGCCCG_Stage
columns.description: The text term used to describe the International Germ Cell Cancer Collaborative Group (IGCCCG), a grouping used to further classify metastatic testicular tumors.

columns.name: INPC_Grade
columns.description: Text term used to describe the classification of neuroblastic differentiation within neuroblastoma tumors, as defined by the International Neuroblastoma Pathology Classification (INPC).

columns.name: Tumor_Focality
columns.description: The text term used to describe whether the patient's disease originated in a single location or multiple locations.

columns.name: Primary_Gleason_Grade
columns.description: The text term used to describe the primary Gleason score, which describes the pattern of cells making up the largest area of the tumor. The primary and secondary Gleason pattern grades are combined to determine the patient's Gleason grade group, which is used to determine the aggresiveness of prostate cancer. Note that this grade describes the entire prostatectomy specimen and is not specific to the sample used for sequencing.

columns.name: AJCC_Clinical_M
columns.description: Extent of the distant metastasis for the cancer based on evidence obtained from clinical assessment parameters determined prior to treatment.

columns.name: Margin_Distance
columns.description: Numeric value (in centimeters) that represents the distance between the tumor and the surgical margin.

columns.name: INRG_Stage
columns.description: The text term used to describe the staging classification of neuroblastic tumors, as defined by the International Neuroblastoma Risk Group (INRG).

columns.name: Non_Nodal_Tumor_Deposits
columns.description: The yes/no/unknown indicator used to describe the presence of tumor deposits in the pericolic or perirectal fat or in adjacent mesentery away from the leading edge of the tumor.

columns.name: Ovarian_Specimen_Status
columns.description: The text term used to describe the physical condition of the involved ovary.

columns.name: Mitosis_Karyorrhexis_Index
columns.description: Text term that represents the component of the International Neuroblastoma Pathology Classification (INPC) for mitosis-karyorrhexis index (MKI).

columns.name: Tumor_Largest_Dimension_Diameter
columns.description: Numeric value used to describe the maximum diameter or dimension of the primary tumor, measured in centimeters.

columns.name: WHO_NTE_Grade
columns.description: WHO NTE Grade

columns.name: Last_Known_Disease_Status
columns.description: Text term that describes the last known state or condition of an individual's neoplasm.

columns.name: Id
columns.description: Unique identifier of entity e.g. a96059eb-81af-4b24-ae50-9242c0d8f819

columns.name: Days_to_Diagnosis
columns.description: Number of days between the date used for index and the date the patient was diagnosed with the malignant disease. If not applicable please enter 'Not Applicable'

columns.name: Lymph_Nodes_Positive
columns.description: The number of lymph nodes involved with disease as determined by pathologic examination.

columns.name: Ovarian_Surface_Involvement
columns.description: The text term that describes whether the surface tissue (outer boundary) of the ovary shows evidence of involvement or presence of cancer.

columns.name: entityId
columns.description: Synapse ID of entity

columns.name: Secondary_Gleason_Grade
columns.description: The text term used to describe the secondary Gleason score, which describes the pattern of cells making up the second largest area of the tumor. The primary and secondary Gleason pattern grades are combined to determine the patient's Gleason grade group, which is used to determine the aggresiveness of prostate cancer. Note that this grade describes the entire prostatectomy specimen and is not specific to the sample used for sequencing.

columns.name: Cog_Rhabdomyosarcoma_Risk_Group
columns.description: Text term used to describe the classification of rhabdomyosarcoma, as defined by the Children's Oncology Group (COG).

columns.name: Days_to_Last_Known_Disease_Status
columns.description: Time interval from the date of last follow up to the date of initial pathologic diagnosis, represented as a calculated number of days. If not applicable please enter 'Not Applicable'

columns.name: Days_to_Progression_Free
columns.description: Number of days between the date used for index and the date the patient's disease was formally confirmed as progression-free. If not applicable please enter 'Not Applicable'

columns.name: AJCC_Clinical_Stage
columns.description: Stage group determined from clinical information on the tumor (T), regional node (N) and metastases (M) and by grouping cases with similar prognosis for cancer.

columns.name: HTAN_Participant_ID
columns.description: HTAN ID associated with a patient based on HTAN ID SOP (eg HTANx_yyy )

columns.name: Cog_Neuroblastoma_Risk_Group
columns.description: Text term that represents the categorization of patients on the basis of prognostic factors per a system developed by Children's Oncology Group (COG). Risk level is used to assign treatment intensity.

columns.name: Lymph_Node_Involved_Site
columns.description: The text term used to describe the anatomic site of lymph node involvement.

columns.name: Days_to_Progression
columns.description: Number of days between the date used for index and the date the patient's disease progressed. If not applicable please enter 'Not Applicable'

columns.name: Vascular_Invasion_Present
columns.description: The yes/no indicator to ask if large vessel or venous invasion was detected by surgery or presence in a tumor specimen.

columns.name: Micropapillary_Features
columns.description: The yes/no/unknown indicator used to describe whether micropapillary features were determined to be present.

columns.name: AJCC_Staging_System_Edition
columns.description: The text term used to describe the version or edition of the American Joint Committee on Cancer Staging Handbooks, a publication by the group formed for the purpose of developing a system of staging for cancer that is acceptable to the American medical profession and is compatible with other accepted classifications.

columns.name: Method_of_Diagnosis
columns.description: Text term used to describe the method used to confirm the patients malignant diagnosis.

columns.name: Pregnant_at_Diagnosis
columns.description: The text term used to indicate whether the patient was pregnant at the time they were diagnosed.

columns.name: Site_of_Resection_or_Biopsy
columns.description: The text term used to describe the anatomic site of the resection or biopsy of the patient's malignant disease, as described by the World Health Organization's (WHO) International Classification of Diseases for Oncology (ICD-O).

columns.name: Precancerous_Condition_Type
columns.description: The classification of pre-cancerous cells found in a specific collection of data being studied by the Consortium for Molecular and Cellular Characterization of Screen-Detected Lesions (MCL).

columns.name: IRS_Group
columns.description: Text term used to describe the classification of rhabdomyosarcoma tumors, as defined by the Intergroup Rhabdomyosarcoma Study (IRS).

columns.name: Classification_of_Tumor
columns.description: Text that describes the kind of disease present in the tumor specimen as related to a specific timepoint.

columns.name: Tumor_Grade
columns.description: Numeric value to express the degree of abnormality of cancer cells, a measure of differentiation and aggressiveness.

columns.name: WHO_CNS_Grade
columns.description: WHO CNS Grade

columns.name: Tissue_or_Organ_of_Origin
columns.description: The text term used to describe the anatomic site of origin, of the patient's malignant disease, as described by the World Health Organization's (WHO) International Classification of Diseases for Oncology (ICD-O).

columns.name: Non_Nodal_Regional_Disease
columns.description: The text term used to describe whether the patient had non-nodal regional disease.

columns.name: INSS_Stage
columns.description: Text term used to describe the staging classification of neuroblastic tumors, as defined by the International Neuroblastoma Staging System (INSS).

columns.name: Tumor_Confined_to_Organ_of_Origin
columns.description: The yes/no/unknown indicator used to describe whether the tumor is confined to the organ where it originated and did not spread to a proximal or distant location within the body.

columns.name: Anaplasia_Present_Type
columns.description: The text term used to describe the morphologic findings indicating the presence of a malignant cellular infiltrate characterized by the presence of large pleomorphic cells, necrosis, and high mitotic activity in a tissue sample.

columns.name: Lymph_Nodes_Tested
columns.description: The number of lymph nodes tested to determine whether lymph nodes were involved with disease as determined by a pathologic examination.

columns.name: Progression_or_Recurrence_Anatomic_Site
columns.description: The text term used to describe the anatomic site of resection; biopsy; tissue or organ of biospecimen origin; progression or recurrent disease; treatment

columns.name: Progression_or_Recurrence_Type
columns.description: The text term used to describe the type of progressive or recurrent disease or relapsed disease.

columns.name: Medulloblastoma_Molecular_Classification
columns.description: The text term used to describe the classification of medulloblastoma tumors based on molecular features.

columns.name: Progression_or_Recurrence
columns.description: Yes/No/unknown indicator to identify whether a patient has had a new tumor event after initial treatment.

columns.name: ISS_Stage
columns.description: The multiple myeloma disease stage at diagnosis.

columns.name: Gleason_Patterns_Percent
columns.description: Numeric value that represents the percentage of Patterns 4 and 5, which is used when the Gleason score is greater than 7 to predict prognosis.

columns.name: Morphology
columns.description: The third edition of the International Classification of Diseases for Oncology, published in 2000 used principally in tumor and cancer registries for coding the site (topography) and the histology (morphology) of neoplasms. The study of the structure of the cells and their arrangement to constitute tissues and, finally, the association among these to form organs. In pathology, the microscopic process of identifying normal and abnormal morphologic characteristics in tissues, by employing various cytochemical and immunocytochemical stains. A system of numbered categories for representation of data.

columns.name: Margins_Involved_Site
columns.description: The text term used to describe the anatomic sites that were involved in the survival margins.

columns.name: AJCC_Pathologic_N
columns.description: The codes that represent the stage of cancer based on the nodes present (N stage) according to criteria based on multiple editions of the AJCC's Cancer Staging Manual.

columns.name: Year_of_Diagnosis
columns.description: Numeric value to represent the year of an individual's initial pathologic diagnosis of cancer.

columns.name: Primary_Diagnosis
columns.description: Text term used to describe the patient's histologic diagnosis, as described by the World Health Organization's (WHO) International Classification of Diseases for Oncology (ICD-O).

columns.name: Supratentorial_Localization
columns.description: Text term to specify the location of the supratentorial tumor.

columns.name: AJCC_Clinical_T
columns.description: Extent of the primary cancer based on evidence obtained from clinical assessment parameters determined prior to treatment.

columns.name: Greatest_Tumor_Dimension
columns.description: Numeric value that represents the measurement of the widest portion of the tumor in centimeters.

columns.name: Perineural_Invasion_Present
columns.description: A yes/no indicator to ask if perineural invasion or infiltration of tumor or cancer is present.

columns.name: Lymphatic_Invasion_Present
columns.description: A yes/no indicator to ask if small or thin-walled vessel invasion is present, indicating lymphatic involvement

columns.name: Tumor_Depth
columns.description: Numeric value that represents the depth of tumor invasion, measured in millimeters (mm).

columns.name: Peritoneal_Fluid_Cytological_Status
columns.description: The text term used to describe the malignant status of the peritoneal fluid determined by cytologic testing.

columns.name: First_Symptom_Prior_to_Diagnosis
columns.description: Text term used to describe the patient's first symptom experienced prior to diagnosis and thought to be related to the disease.

columns.name: Anaplasia_Present
columns.description: Yes/no/unknown/Not Reported indicator used to describe whether anaplasia was present at the time of diagnosis.

columns.name: Prior_Treatment
columns.description: A yes/no/unknown/not applicable indicator related to the administration of therapeutic agents received before the body specimen was collected.

columns.name: Laterality
columns.description: For tumors in paired organs, designates the side on which the cancer originates.

columns.name: Gleason_Grade_Tertiary
columns.description: The text term used to describe the tertiary pattern as described by the Gleason Grading System.

columns.name: International_Prognostic_Index
columns.description: The text term used to describe the International Prognostic Index, which classifies the prognosis of patients with aggressive non-Hodgkin's lymphoma.

columns.name: Breslow_Thickness
columns.description: The number that describes the distance, in millimeters, between the upper layer of the epidermis and the deepest point of tumor penetration.

columns.name: Vascular_Invasion_Type
columns.description: Text term that represents the type of vascular tumor invasion.

columns.name: Residual_Disease
columns.description: Text terms to describe the status of a tissue margin following surgical resection.

columns.description: Numeric value (or unknown) to represent the number of years a person has been smoking.

columns.name: Pack_Years_Smoked
columns.description: Numeric computed value to represent lifetime tobacco exposure defined as number of cigarettes smoked per day x number of years smoked divided by 20.

columns.name: Tobacco_Smoking_Status

columns.name: Attribute
columns.description: Key characteristic X of the assay, related protocol, or downstream data that we want to record as metadata feature.

columns.name: Description
columns.description: Provide a definition or a reference containing the definition of attribute X. Preferably provide a source ontology link or code in addition to the definition. Leave blank if the final description is pending.

columns.name: Valid_Values
columns.description: The range of attribute X: the values that can be assigned to attribute X; these values can include/be other attributes (i.e. listed in the 'Attribute' columns) themselves. Comma separated. If none provided any non-null value is valid for attribute X.

columns.name: DependsOn
columns.description: Important characteristics, if any, of attribute X that need to be recorded as metadata features given attribute X is specified. These characteristics could be attributes or properties of attributes (i.e. they are listed in the 'Attribute' column and/or under the 'Properties' column). Comma separated.

columns.name: Properties
columns.description: Properties specific to a particular attribute; note that properties could be attributes themselves (i.e. listed under the 'Attributes' column).

columns.name: Required
columns.description: Indicate if specifying value for attribute X is mandatory or optional by default. Set to TRUE or FALSE. If TRUE, a data contributor must provide a value for attribute X (e.g. one of the valid values in 'Valid Values', if any are specified). If FALSE, a data contributor may select between 'Not Applicable' or 'Not Specified' as a value for attribute X. Note that an attribute may not be required by default (i.e. 'Required' is set to FALSE), but it could be required by virtue of being an attribute of another required attribute (e.g. see ERCC).

columns.name: Parent
columns.description: Parent class of this attribute - i.e. where to 'hook' this attribute into an existing schema. Note that this assumes a single existing schema/a single json-ld schema context; if we need to support classes/attributes/properties defined across multiple schemas/json-ld contexts we'd need to add a schema/context column that specifies the context of each attribute, if different from the context of the attribute's parent.
